title: Production Data and ML Platform
titleEs: Plataforma de datos y ML de producción
problemStatement: When Netflix's recommendation team published its MLOps practices, the headline was not the model but the rollback: every deploy could be reversed in minutes, and every model could be traced to its data. A platform without rollback is a gamble; a platform without lineage is a guess. In this capstone you will implement data and model lineage, reproducible experiments, dataset versioning, a registry, model or artifact signatures, train/serve consistency, CI/CD, staging, an approval gate, shadow or canary evaluation, service-level objectives, rollback, last-known-good recovery, and change and incident records. The project must prove rollback rather than merely documenting it.
problemStatementEs: Cuando el equipo de recomendación de Netflix publicó sus prácticas MLOps, el titular no fue el modelo sino el rollback: cada despliegue podía revertirse en minutos, y cada modelo podía rastrearse hasta sus datos. Una plataforma sin rollback es una apuesta; una plataforma sin lineaje es una conjetura. En este capstone implementarás lineaje de datos y modelo, experimentos reproducibles, versionado de datasets, un registro, firmas de modelo o artefacto, consistencia train/serve, CI/CD, staging, una compuerta de aprobación, evaluación shadow o canary, objetivos de nivel de servicio, rollback, recuperación de último-bueno y registros de cambios e incidentes. El proyecto debe probar el rollback en lugar de simplemente documentarlo.
learningOutcomes: Version datasets and register models with signatures.
Run shadow/canary with SLOs and proven rollback.

syntheticDataContract.generator: Synthetic model artifacts and datasets with versioned lineage
syntheticDataContract.schema: model_id, version, dataset_version, signature, train_metric, serve_metric, slo_status, rollback_target

acceptanceCriteria: Lineage resolves any artifact to its inputs.
CI/CD pipeline promotes via staging with an approval gate.
Shadow or canary evaluation is present.
Change and incident records are kept.

levels.description: All acceptance criteria pass on the canonical fixtures.
Core paths pass; minor edge cases fail with a clear reason.
Core paths fail or behave non-deterministically.
Malformed input quarantined; denominators correct; failures explained.
Failures handled but reasons are thin.
Failures crash the program or lose data.
Normal, boundary and failure tests present and passing.
Happy-path tests only, or boundary tests missing.
No meaningful tests, or tests fabricated.
Clear module boundaries; typed contracts; small functions.
Readable but with some coupling.
Monolithic, hard to extend or test.
Reproduces from a clean environment in one command.
Reproduces with manual steps.
Cannot reproduce outside the author's machine.
No secrets; synthetic data; least privilege; secure logging.
Minor gaps with documented remediation.
Exposed secret, real PII, or unsafe operation.
No unsupported inference; human review; correction mechanism.
Mostly responsible with one unclear claim.
Automated adverse decision or unsupported causal claim.
Inspectible traces, manifests, and lineage.
Some evidence present but incomplete.
No inspectible evidence.
Clear brief, demo and limitations; truthful CV narrative.
Demonstrable but with unclear framing.
No demo or misleading claims.
Criterion fully satisfied with inspectable evidence.
Criterion partially satisfied.
Criterion not satisfied.

criticalFailures: Use of real confidential, personal, employer-owned or regulated information.
Committed secret or credential in the repository or logs.
Unsafe SQL or unparameterised query that enables injection.
Public sensitive attachment or unredacted PII in outputs.
Automatic unsupported fraud, kinship, collusion, criminal-association, beneficial-ownership or causal-relationship inference.
Unapproved external side effect (email send, API call, file mutation).
Fabricated test evidence or a ledger substituted for execution evidence.
Inaccessible core workflow (no keyboard operation, colour-only encoding).
Unresolved critical security, privacy or responsible-use defect.
Final demonstration that cannot be reproduced from the artifact repo.
Rollback documented but never executed; train/serve skew unresolved.

remediationPaths: If train/serve skew exists: align feature pipelines
If rollback is unproven: execute a drill and record it
If SLOs are missing: define and monitor them
